title: Recorded resume-page capture stream contains no application_draft_resumed, contradicting the notes/README claim it fires at load
evidence:
20-analytics-resume-page.json: "{
 "freshFormSectionEvents": "see note",
 "resumePageEvents": [
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "application_draft_saved",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture",
  "$autocapture"
 ],
 "tokenInAnyPayload": false,
 "botFilterUA": true
}" — vs 21-analytics-notes.md:22-24: "the resume page fires
  application_draft_resumed at load (payload {vacancy_short_code} only).
- Recorded on the resume page: 10 × $autocapture + application_draft_saved."
detail: The notes and README step-7 row assert application_draft_resumed fires at load, but the committed recorded stream (16 events) omits it and the omission is never reconciled. Verified apply_analytics.js fires it in the init outcome branch and scripts/js-tests/apply_analytics.test.js:111-112,132 pins the mapping — evidence-collection gap (wrapper attached post-load), not a product defect.
recommended_fix: Amend 21-analytics-notes.md to state the load-time application_draft_resumed cannot appear in the post-load-wrapped stream and is pinned by the unit test, or re-record with the wrapper installed pre-init.

title: README claims no-JS render has "no hidden attrs" — committed 17-nojs-long-form.html contains 5 hidden attributes
evidence: README.md step-6 row: "PASS — curl (no JS): GET renders all 8 data-section-id with no hidden attrs, both attestation radios (attested/declined, required)" — vs grep of 17-nojs-long-form.html: "w\" data-index=\"0\" data-initially-hidden=\"true\" data-testid=\"income-source-row-0\" hidden>" (rows 0-2) and "<div data-condition=\"co_applicant_sharing\" data-condition-value=\"yes\" hidden>" (×2).
detail: The unqualified "no hidden attrs" claim is contradicted by the artifact: 3 income-source rows and 2 co_applicant_sharing conditional wrappers render hidden, and without JS a no-JS user can never reveal those optional fields. The 8 section fieldsets themselves are unhidden, so the step-6 PASS stands.
recommended_fix: Reword README step 6 to "all 8 sections render unhidden; JS-only conditional optional fields (extra income rows, co-applicant cards) stay hidden in no-JS — core submit unaffected".

title: Acceptance requires suites green "BEFORE and AFTER your pass" — README documents only the BEFORE baseline
evidence: Briefing Acceptance: "The existing 57-scenario suite + all `make test` / `make test-integration` suites green on develop BEFORE and AFTER your pass." — vs README.md:56: "Unit + integration baselines BEFORE the pass: `make test` green (shared, client, server, 98 node js-tests), 377 integration tests green against the local Docker DB."
detail: No AFTER re-run is recorded anywhere in the deliverable. The PR carries zero application-code changes so the risk is nil, but the acceptance criterion explicitly requires both endpoints and only one is documented.
recommended_fix: Add one README line recording the post-pass `make test` / `make test-integration` result (or state it is unchanged because the diff contains no app-code delta).

title: Save-resume (step 5) DB claims cite uncommitted "verify-run DB checks" — no draft/resume DB dump in the evidence directory
evidence: README.md step-5 row: "resumed_at stamped on first post-resume save; submit from restored draft → confirmation + application row | 14-continue-link-requested.png, 15-resume-restored.png, 16-resume-submitted-confirmation.png (+ verify-run DB checks)" — directory contains DB dumps only for steps 4 (13-db-state-journey-submission.txt) and 6 (19-db-state-nojs.txt).
detail: Step 5's DB-specific assertions (draft row per step-change, token minted at save time, resumed_at stamped, application row from the resumed draft) rest on checks that were never committed as artifacts, unlike steps 4 and 6 which have DB dumps. The step is evidenced by screenshots, but its DB claims are unverifiable from the committed record.
recommended_fix: Commit a DB dump of the application_draft/application rows for the resumed applicant (mirroring 13/19) showing resumed_at and the attested submission.
